ruleDefinitions.name: Remote Utilities Host Service Install
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Remote Utilities Host service installation on the target system. Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ImagePath, ServiceName

sequences.query: ((Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045) AND ((ImagePath = RGX(".*\\\\rutserv\\\.exe.*") AND ImagePath = RGX(".*\\-service.*")) OR ServiceName = "Remote\ Utilities\ \-\ Host"))
